title: Seagrove Beach "Reposado" 7 Dalton Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Steps from beach access- Access to Eastern Lake- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $65 per day.- Grill- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Troubles fade at Reposado, a 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom home in Seagrove Beach that comfortably accommodates 12 guests. Brimming with natural beauty and classic beach charm, Seagrove Beach is known for ample beaches and family-friendly activities both on and off the water. Guests will be delighted by this home’s private outdoor retreat and 1-minute beach access!Take the outdoor staircase to the second floor, where the main kitchen and living spaces reside. An open-concept space, decorated with a mix of beach-inspired elements and contemporary furnishings. Relax with the family on the comfortable sofa and armchairs in the living area, and stream a favorite movie on the 70” Smart TV. In the kitchen, high-end appliances and a spacious waterfall island, with seating for 3, create an enticing setting for guests to cook meals and prepare snacks. Choose to dine inside at the modern 6-person dining table or on the screened-in balcony at the 6-person alfresco table overlooking the pool and patio. This floor hosts a guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom.Down the spiral staircase on the first floor, discover 2 guest bedrooms, 1 bunk room, a kitchenette, and a laundry room. The first guest bedroom has a queen bed, and the second has a king bed, private bathroom, and access to the furnished screened-in porch. The bunk room is perfect for children or teens with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds. Outside, bask in the Florida sun by the private pool, or rest in the shaded pavilion and enjoy the coastal breeze. For guests who love cooking outdoors, there is a grill. Turn on the outdoor gas fireplace as night falls to keep the fun going into the twilight hours.Prepare for days of sunny serenity at Reposado in Seagrove Beach. Parking for 4 vehicles makes exploration easy, and guests who prefer traveling on 2-wheels can take advantage of the 4 complimentary adult bikes. For beach access, pick between the Eastern Lake (1 min.), Walton Dunes (5 min.), and Santa Clara (6 min.) accesses. Book this delightful beach home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-TwinBunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Half Bath
